evidence: CustomUnitLoader sets l.bg when queuedUnits animation exists and when any whenBuilding_* runtime action effect is present: cannotMove, playAnimation, rotateTo, temporarilyConvertTo, or triggerAction. CustomUnit.update then gates the whole build-queue conversion/animation branch on metadata.bg or revertMetadata.bg.
notes: Broad metadata-level gate for queued build animations and whenBuilding runtime conversion/action effects.

evidence: CustomUnit.update stores CustomAction.isWhenBuildingCannotMove into j.g while processing the current build-queue action; if true it zeroes movement velocities cc/cd/cf and CustomUnit.I() returns false while g is set.
notes: Per-unit runtime latch, not the metadata capability flag.

evidence: Constructor initializes j.i=true. The first CustomUnit.update clears i, runs creation render behaviors, and fires CustomUnitEventType.CREATED; the pre-update createdAnimation branch also checks i before playing metadata.createdAnimation.
Constructor initializes j.h=true. Later in CustomUnit.update, after behavior update hooks run, h is cleared and CustomUnitEventType.COMPLETE_AND_ACTIVE is fired.
notes: First active-frame COMPLETE_AND_ACTIVE event pending flag.

evidence: LegAnimationBehavior computes leg/base motion deltas from current unit eo minus j.dP, then refreshes dP to the current unit x position; CustomUnit.du and reset-position paths also initialize dP from eo.

LegAnimationBehavior computes leg/base motion deltas from current unit ep minus j.dQ, then refreshes dQ to the current unit y position; CustomUnit.du and reset-position paths also initialize dQ from ep.
LegAnimationBehavior computes leg/base height deltas from current unit eq minus j.dR, then refreshes dR to the current unit height; CustomUnit.du and reset-position paths also initialize dR from eq.

LegAnimationBehavior computes leg/base directional deltas from current body/main-turret direction minus j.dS, then refreshes dS to the current direction; CustomUnit.du and reset-position paths initialize dS from body dir or the lockLegRotationWithMainTurret turret dir.
CustomUnit auto-trigger update decrements j.w when positive; after a matching autoTrigger fires it resets w from CustomUnitMetadata.autoTriggerCooldownTime, preventing immediate repeat firing.
notes: Included because the same custom-action runtime update area touches construction/conversion effects and auto-trigger action dispatch.
